scenes.narration: Nobody ever programmed ChatGPT to answer you.
Welcome to FredsDesk, lesson one. In under a minute, you'll know what AI really is.
AI is software that learns patterns from examples, instead of following rules a person wrote by hand.
scenes.definition: Software that learns patterns from examples instead of following hand-written rules.

scenes.narration: Normal software is a recipe, followed step by step, exactly as written. AI is different. Nobody writes the rules. It studies millions of examples, and finds the patterns itself.
Here's how. First, feed it lots of examples. Training adjusts the model until it spots the pattern. Then it uses that pattern to predict answers for things it has never seen.
scenes.note: Learn from the past, predict the new

scenes.narration: You already use it daily. Spam filters, face unlock, maps, and keyboard suggestions all run on AI.
scenes.label: AI tools already in your phone
scenes.sub: Spam filter · Face unlock · Maps · Keyboard

scenes.narration: Quick recap. One: AI learns from examples. Two: it finds patterns, not rules. Three: it predicts answers for new things.
points: It predicts answers for new things
